These declines followed the inversion and uninversion, showing the historical pattern held. However, the official two-quarter GDP decline definition was not met in 2022 due to a revision, and the 2025 decline was only one quarter, leading to definitional disputes. The speaker argues that the binary definition is arbitrary and a more flexible interpretation shows the recession has indeed occurred.

A single quarter of a huge decline can be more significant than four quarters of slight decline. In 2022, two consecutive quarters of decline were initially reported but then one was revised upward, so the official designation was avoided. This binary definition does not capture the financial struggle of everyday Americans.
